## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian personal-finance episode (VG's Pengerådet). It covers the recent tech-led sell-off after the US midterms, with Nvidia hit further by a scandal involving its CEO, plus Norwegian house prices, CPI and rates, and electricity prices under Norgespris. Most of the episode argues that the market drop is a good time to start saving in IPS, Norway's private pension account, because of its tax advantages, and it warns about high bank fees and early de-risking in ready-made fund profiles. No company gets an explicit buy or sell call; the hosts recommend cheap global index funds over single stocks.
